findings.resolution: Typed execution results and exhaustive release-decision tests added.
Dashboard now presents evidence basis rather than probability.
Exact structured manifest coverage and two-reviewer approval are enforced.
Dashboard and canonical docs now distinguish deterministic stages and strategy foundations from planned model, live-tool, browser and execution verticals.

Every executed workflow stage now emits a bounded typed success, abstention or sanitized failure event and deliverable with capabilities, opaque evidence/artifact references, policy identity, measurements, gaps and next action.
Open vertical-slice boundaries are recorded in the retrospective ledger and remain FOUNDATION or NEXT rather than being presented as complete.
